v: Attitude is Everything kaadu... NANI is everything 😄 Logic theatre bayata switch off chesi vellandi. Story nonsense aina Nani alone makes it proper paisa vasool.
e: Nenu Local is one of those films where taking your logical brain into the theatre is actively dangerous. The story and screenplay make little sense, but Trinadha Rao Nakkina designs the hero for maximum entertainment and Nani gives that character 200%, while DSP gets room to try a few different musical ideas. As entertainment, it works almost entirely because of Nani, Nani and Nani.
body:
with Tag line Attitude is everything but for this movie its “Nani’s Attitude is the onlything”

How can he act with such an ease……I may be exaggerating but looks like he is going to be the next big thing in tollywood after MegaStar

Not working with a Star was a blessing for DSP as he tried some different tunes unlike his other movies.

Just like Cinema Chupistha Mama, the director has done what he knows the best…..take an illogical story make it entertaining by desugning a typical hero char who can produce a lot of entertainment and Nanni did 200% justification

Story n Screenplay wise it is one of those Sajid Khan movies which you cant dare or dream to take your mind to theaters. Probably they should add a warning along with the regular Cell Switch Off warnings to warn the audience against useing their loggical brain or brain while watching the cinema

Entertainment wise its purely paisa vasool just because of Nani Nani and Nani….

v: Glad I did NOT miss this one 🙏 Railway Raju vs Imtiaz vs TIME itself... tight screenplay, terrific BGM and hardly one useless scene. Ee cinema deserves more love.
e: Appatlo Okadundevadu tracks the rise and fall of Railway Raju and Imtiaz almost like two destinies moving in opposite rhythms. The direction and editing are terrific, every scene feels relevant, contemporary ideas such as piracy and real-estate change are woven intelligently into the period story, and Sree Vishnu leads a uniformly strong cast in a rare film that stays entertaining without formula tracks.
body:
Watched #AppatloOkadundevadu ……. Glad i didnt missed this movie, Its all about Railyway Raju vs Imtiaz vs Time/Destiny and wonderfully describes the Raise, Fall, Raise, Fall & Raise of Railyway Rajus fate against the Fall, Raise, Fall, Raise & Raise of Imtiaz fate!!!!

Direction n Editing are terrific….You cannnot find one scene/shot which is irrelavant to story line. The way director/writer corelates the Switch Hit, Piracy, Kktpally real estate withh current scenarios shows their sheer brilliance. Screenplay is apt for the storyline. BGM is terrific and songs though in sync with story and could have been better. This is one such rare film which shows that you dont need formula nd comedy tracks to keep the audience hooked nd entertained.

Terrific performances by Sri Vishnu, Rohit, Prabhas Seenu, Bhramaji, Rajeev Kanakala & Ajay.

Sri Vishnu proved he is a wonderful actor esp after Pratinidhi….wonder how Tollywood ignored this fine actor, hope he gets superb roles going forward….

Take a bow Rohit for getting back into his experimentation zone and also producing the movie.

v: Old family storyే... but clean ga, warm ga, mana intlo vallala characters tho chepthe fresh ga feel avvachu ani prove chesindi 😄 LOVED IT TO THE CORE.
e: Shatamanam Bhavati takes an age-old family-and-village template and shows that execution can still make familiar material feel fresh. Beautiful visuals and characters who resemble people we actually know keep the film warm and engaging, even if the songs and BGM could have been stronger. For me, it was simply a perfect family entertainer.
body:
Watched #ShatamanamBhavati …… a perfect family entertainer, loved it to the core. You always dont need any exceptional out of box story or screenplay to keep audience engaged, sometimes u can do the magic with age old story and screenplay with a clean and fresh entertainment.

Coming to the story it is a kichidi of all well known family and village backdrop films, but the beautifully captured visuals and entertainment from nearly Real charachters is want keeps you engaged. Except for Prakash Raj, Anupama & Sharwanand all the other chars are pretty much real and can be corelated. BGM and Songs could have been better.

v: Did I go for a fresh story? NO 😂 BOSS comeback kosam vella... comedy, emotion, dance, screen fire అన్నీ intact. BOX-OFFICE AMMA MOGUDU IS BACK!!!!!
e: Khaidi No. 150 did not need an original story to work for me because I was there for Chiranjeevi’s comeback, and he delivers exactly the reminder fans wanted. His comedy timing, emotional ease, drunk performance, graceful dancing and sheer screen presence dominate everything around him. There may be little else to discuss — but Boss okkadu chaalu 😄
body:
watched #Khaidi150…..assalu tamil ollaki adhi oka goppa story anni ella anipinchindho?? Telugu lo same story line based 150 cinemalu chupinchachu 🙂 but wait a minute…..did I watch the movie for a different story or execution?? NO its BOSS comeback movie!!! and yes The Boss who had kick ass comedy timing is back….The Boss who is pitch perfect as drunkurd is back…..The Boss who is at best in emotional scenes is back……The Boss who sets Silver screen on Fire with his graceful steps is back….and YES the BOXOFFICE amma mogudu is BACK with Bang!!!! My 4 year old daughter danced in the theater for the songs and Yes the biggest entertainer of Telugu Film Industry is back

Boss gurunchi thappa cinema lo chepukodaniki emmi ledhu…..but Boss okkadu challu 😛
